# dpa Picture-Alliance

> > dpa Picture-Alliance is a leading visual content marketplace providing news images, stock photos, videos, and infographics for editorial and commercial use.

Operating as a press and photo agency, dpa Picture-Alliance serves media organizations and businesses with comprehensive visual content covering breaking news, sports photography, and licensed stock imagery. The platform specializes in editorial photography with coverage of major events including Formula 1, Winter Olympics 2026, and international news.
